# MyStat 1.3.1
Update MyStat directly from **Settings → Check for Updates…**. Sparkle downloads the update, verifies it, replaces the app, and relaunches it.
- Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized Mac release. - Signed update archive and feed enable in-place installation from existing updater-enabled versions. - Includes the focused Overview, secondary Details/iPhone/Settings pages, and native materials introduced in 1.3.0, with Liquid Glass on macOS 26+. - Existing preferences are preserved. Restarting ends an active Keep Awake session; enable it again after the update if needed.
Universal Apple silicon / Intel app, macOS 12+. This release updates the Mac companion only.
Validation: Developer ID signature, stapled notarization ticket, and Gatekeeper acceptance verified. An isolated 1.3.0 installation downloaded this exact signed archive through Sparkle, installed it, and relaunched as 1.3.1 with saved Keep Awake preferences preserved. Core, dropdown, and Keep Awake regression checks passed for the unchanged application code in 1.3.0.

item.title: MyStat 1.3.0 — GitHub download
item.description:
Choose **Learn More…** to open GitHub and download this release. Quit MyStat before replacing the app in Applications.
# MyStat 1.3.0
A more focused Mac dropdown with native translucent materials and Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later.
- **Overview** keeps CPU, memory, and a compact Keep Awake switch close at hand. Click the Keep Awake heading to reveal duration and display options. - **Details**, **iPhone**, and **Settings** put additional readings, connected devices, and app controls on separate pages. Back or Escape returns to Overview; reopening the dropdown always starts there. - Floating process panels and Back buttons use native Liquid Glass on macOS 26+. Older versions of macOS use native fallback materials and controls. - System colors, lighter chart styling, and standard segmented controls adapt to light and dark appearance. Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast are respected. - Corrected the build's SDK metadata so AppKit uses the current native control design while retaining macOS 12 compatibility. - Preserved reliable menu-bar dismissal, process-panel interactions, keyboard shortcuts, and Keep Awake preferences.
**GitHub-only macOS release:** universal Apple silicon / Intel, macOS 12+. This build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized; macOS may block its first launch. Check for Updates offers a “Learn More…” link to this GitHub download. Installation is manual; Sparkle does not automatically download or install this build.
Quit MyStat before replacing the app in Applications. Quitting ends an active Keep Awake session; enable it again after relaunching if needed. This updates the Mac companion only; the iOS submission is unchanged.
Validation: all 30 core tests, dropdown hierarchy and layout checks, keyboard navigation, repeated menu-button dismissal, side-panel placement, Keep Awake session lifecycle and native sleep assertions, and live light/dark appearance checks. The universal release archive includes a SHA-256 checksum.

# MyStat 1.2.1
Clicking the menu-bar graphs again now reliably dismisses the dashboard.
- Fixed a timing race that could close the pop-up on mouse-down and immediately reopen it on mouse-up. - Closing the dashboard also dismisses an attached process panel. Clicking inside a process panel still keeps the dashboard open. - Chart hover and keyboard tracking now starts only when the dashboard opens.
**GitHub-only macOS release:** universal Apple silicon / Intel, macOS 12+. This build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized; macOS may block its first launch. Check for Updates offers a “Learn More…” link to this GitHub download. Installation is manual; Sparkle does not automatically download or install this build.
Quit MyStat before replacing the app in Applications. This updates the Mac companion only; the iOS submission is unchanged.
Validation: all 30 core tests, dropdown layout and side-panel placement checks, repeated menu-button toggles, and dismissal with a process panel attached. The universal release build includes a SHA-256 checksum. Automated desktop UI inspection was unavailable; interaction checks exercised the AppKit popover directly.

item.description:
Choose **Learn More…** to open GitHub and download this release. Quit MyStat before replacing the app in Applications.
# MyStat 1.2.0
The Mac dashboard is easier to read, process lists no longer cover other readings, and Keep Awake can now keep your display on.
- **Side process panels:** CPU and memory lists open to the left or right to fit your screen. Hover to preview, click to pin, or use C / M to switch and Escape to close. - **Process icons:** recognize apps at a glance, including their helper processes. System processes use a fallback symbol. - **Redesigned dashboard:** larger readings, compact metric cards, labeled percentage axes, subtle chart grids, and light/dark styling. - **Keep Awake:** a switch, “Active until” status, and ∞ / 15m / 30m / 45m / 1h / 4h / 8h presets. Keep display on is enabled by default; turn it off to allow display sleep while monitoring continues. - **Automatic expiry:** macOS enforces timed sessions. Switching off or quitting releases sleep protection. Preferences are remembered, but sessions do not resume on launch. Manual sleep and lid closure still take priority.
**GitHub-only macOS release:** universal Apple silicon / Intel, macOS 12+. This build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized; macOS may block its first launch. Check for Updates offers a “Learn More…” link to this GitHub download. Installation is manual; Sparkle does not automatically download or install this build.
Quit MyStat before replacing the app in Applications. This updates the Mac companion only; the iOS submission is unchanged.
Validation: 30 core tests, dropdown and side-panel placement checks, Keep Awake lifecycle and real macOS assertion/expiry checks, and a universal release build. The download includes a SHA-256 checksum.
